channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Isaiah Hartenstein | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Isaiah Hartenstein from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jay Williams on Dan Hurley, Isaiah Hartenstein, Chet Holmgren, Aday Mara
item.description:
NBA Courtside:Jay Willams says OKC and the Spurs won the draft:

“They continue to put their chokehold on the NBA.What did we talk about a lot with OKC? How did Chet Holmgren play in the NBA finals? What’s going on with Isaiah Hartenstein when he had go against Wemby? That got a guy named Aday Mara who has a 7’4 wingspan, super talented can give you depth off the bench and give you an extra body to go against Wemby. How about for San Antonio for Wembanyama we talked a lot about who’s the enforcer when Kornet played in that series, now you bring a guy that brings a lot of physicality played for Dan Hurley at UConn a absolute beast on the glass.”

Jay Williams on Dan Hurley, Isaiah Hartenstein, Chet Holmgren, Aday Mara, Jun 24, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Isaiah Hartenstein
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:SGA on his on-court interview postgame about Isaiah Hartenstein:

“I didn't really hear. Then when I realized what she said, I gave her the right answer.”

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Isaiah Hartenstein, May 21, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jared McCain on Tyrese Maxey, Isaiah Hartenstein
item.description:
Jared McCain on if he has played alongside a big man who can make screening a highlight play like Isaiah Hartenstein:

“It’s crazy. When I was in Philly, Joel would do that with Tyrese and I was like ‘Dang, that’s really cool right there.’ So being able to be a part of it is really fun. Playing with Hart, J-Will and Chet, they’re all elite bigs. I’m excited to play with them.”

Jared McCain on Tyrese Maxey, Isaiah Hartenstein, Mar 17, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Isaiah Hartenstein
item.description:
In a press conference after the game, Daigneault said the decision was made due to health considerations, as SGA is recovering from an abdominal strain injury.

“We actually discussed that situation with both him and [Isaiah Hartenstein] before the game,”

Mark Daigneault on Isaiah Hartenstein, Feb 28, 2026. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Sam Presti on Isaiah Hartenstein
item.description:
Sam Presti on Isaiah Hartenstein:

“I haven't seen a player become more ingrained in this community faster than Isaiah. It needs to be said out loud. He's done more community work than I think I've ever seen a player do.”

Sam Presti on Isaiah Hartenstein, Jun 30, 2025. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Sam Presti on Alex Caruso, Isaiah Hartenstein
item.description:
Presti on Caruso and Hartenstein:

“Their personalities were so well suited for this particular team at this particular team. I don't know if that'll ever happen that we find two elite role players that are happy being role players that are tailor made for our program.”

Sam Presti on Alex Caruso, Isaiah Hartenstein, Jun 30, 2025. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Isaiah Hartenstein, Chet Holmgren
item.description:
Mark Daigneault on revisiting the Holmgren-Hartenstein starting lineup:

“We keep everything fluid for a reason so that it’s not these seismic events when we change a lineup at any point in time. We changed the starting lineup during the season, coming out of halftime. We changed the rotation almost nightly in the regular season and playoffs. We try to normalize that for situations where we can be opportunistic.”

Mark Daigneault on Isaiah Hartenstein, Chet Holmgren, May 25, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Josh Hart on Julius Randle, Isaiah Hartenstein
item.description:
“We’re going to compare ourselves to last year, for what? We don’t got Donte, we don’t got [Isaiah Hartenstein], we don’t got [Julius Randle].… We don’t have any of those guys. And now we got a totally different group and a totally different personality.”

Josh Hart on Julius Randle, Isaiah Hartenstein, Apr 27, 2025. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Alex Caruso on Isaiah Hartenstein, Kenrich Williams
item.description:
“I’m the oldest guy on the team—me and Kenrich [Williams]. Hart’s [Isaiah Hartenstein] only 26,”

Alex Caruso on Isaiah Hartenstein, Kenrich Williams, Mar 6, 2025. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Jalen Williams on Isaiah Hartenstein
item.description:
Jalen Williams on Isaiah Hartenstein’s passing:

“Hart is a very skilled big man. I think that was one of the things when we first got him that went under the radar.”

Jalen Williams on Isaiah Hartenstein, Mar 4, 2025. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Sam Presti on Alex Caruso, Isaiah Hartenstein
item.description:
“This year we have two significant additions in Isaiah Hartenstein and Alex Caruso.”

Sam Presti on Alex Caruso, Isaiah Hartenstein, Sep 25, 2024. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Sam Presti on Isaiah Hartenstein
item.description:
Sam Presti on Isaiah Hartenstein:

“He's a connecting player. People want to play with players like that. He's worked extremely hard to get to this point of his career. He's still very young. That's one of the things we're also really excited about.”

Sam Presti on Isaiah Hartenstein, Jul 6, 2024. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Sam Presti on Isaiah Hartenstein
item.description:
Sam Presti on Isaiah Hartenstein:

“His game doesn't conflict with the development of our core players... Caruso is similar. They both bring things to the team that are very additive.”

Sam Presti on Isaiah Hartenstein, Jul 6, 2024. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Sam Presti on Isaiah Hartenstein
item.description:
Sam Presti on his FA visit to Isaiah Hartenstein:

“When it comes to trying to make the Thunder better, we'll go across the world if we have to do that.”

Sam Presti on Isaiah Hartenstein, Jul 6, 2024. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Isaiah Hartenstein
item.description:
Tom Thibodeau on the diving steal from Hartenstein:

“That was unbelievable. Those are the kinds of plays, they inspire, they unite. If that doesn't get you excited — probably even you guys got excited.”

Tom Thibodeau on Isaiah Hartenstein, Apr 7, 2024. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Kelly Oubre on Isaiah Hartenstein, Donte DiVincenzo
item.description:
Kelly Oubre on the scuffle with Isaiah Hartenstein/Donte DiVincenzo:

“I don’t got no enemies in this league. It was just funny. All of that stuff is funny to me. I don’t know why. I just laugh ‘cause nobody’s gonna fight. So at the end of the day, I’ll see you Tuesday, bruv.”

Kelly Oubre on Isaiah Hartenstein, Donte DiVincenzo, Mar 11, 2024. Source: Twitter @Krisplashed.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Isaiah Hartenstein
item.description:
Alykhan Bijani:Coach D'Antoni on what Isaiah Hartenstein needs to do to get more time:

“He plays well. It's just how the game goes and what we need. Without Russell (Westbrook), it's a little bit easier to go bigger because of the spacing... If the game dictates it, then, yeah, I'd use Isaiah.”

Mike D'Antoni on Isaiah Hartenstein, Feb 4, 2020. Source: Twitter @Rockets_Insider.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Isaiah Hartenstein
item.description:
Salman Ali:Mike D'Antoni on Isaiah Hartenstein:

“He's got a great knowledge of the offense and what we are trying to do. What was keeping him out before was getting 4 fouls in 2 minutes... He always could do the offensive part, it was the other part.”

Mike D'Antoni on Isaiah Hartenstein, Jan 2, 2020. Source: Twitter @SalmanAliNBA.
